ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee to the rider; log the false "I'm Here" arrival mark; flag the driver account for review and issue a reminder on arrival-location accuracy.
ruling.reasoning:
The driver cancelled claiming rider no-show [F3], so NS-1 governs. NS-1(i) requires the driver to have arrived — "I'm Here" pressed or auto-confirmed with GPS within 200 m of the pickup point. The GPS record is to the contrary: the closest approach was 599 m [F1], the driver was stationary 599 m away the whole time [F2], and after tapping "I'm Here" at 13:01:00 he stayed within 200 m for 0 s [F6]. The platform's recorded arrival [F5] is therefore contradicted by telemetry, and system records override statements (driver statement F14 and chat F9).

Condition (i) fails, and condition (iv) also fails (never at the pickup point). The rider's own chat [F10] confirms he was waiting at the pickup point. NS-2 applies: any NS-1 condition failing voids the fee, so the $5.00 cancellation fee [F3][F7] is refunded in full.

Additionally, the driver marked arrival while GPS was not at the pickup point [F6], which under NS-2 triggers flag_account, and the driver's profile shows an upheld no-show dispute in the last 90 days [F19]. No safety content appears in the chats, complaint or driver statement, so no escalation is required.

element_findings.element: Driver arrived at the pickup point (NS-1(i): 'I'm Here' or auto-arrival with GPS within 200 m)
element_findings.reason: Arrival was recorded at 13:01:00, but GPS puts the driver 599 m from the pickup point then, never coming within 200 m, and 0 s within the radius after the tap. System GPS overrides the arrival mark.

element_findings.element: 5-minute free wait elapsed before cancelling (NS-1(ii), counted from the later of scheduled pickup and arrival)
element_findings.reason: Cancelled 3 min 30 s after the recorded arrival and 6 min 30 s after acceptance; the wait threshold was reached (no separate no-show threshold in the record).

element_findings.element: Driver sent ≥1 in-app message and made ≥1 in-app call before cancelling (NS-1(iii))
element_findings.reason: Two in-app messages (first 13:01:25) and one in-app call (13:02:30) precede the 13:04:30 cancellation; call went unanswered, which is the rider's choice.

element_findings.element: Driver stayed at the pickup point throughout (NS-1(iv))
element_findings.reason: The driver remained stationary 599 m away for the entire 3 min 30 s, never at the pickup point.

element_findings.element: Reason the driver cancelled (NS-0: no-show vs other)
element_findings.reason: App reason rider_no_show, chat 'More than 5 min already, I have to cancel' and the driver's statement all claim no-show; the claim fails factually on arrival location, not on the stated reason.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he waited at the pickup point is contradicted by GPS (F1, F2, F6): he was stationary 599 m away and never within 200 m. Statements yield to system records.
Recorded arrival at 13:01:00 is contradicted by GPS showing the driver 599 m from the pickup point at that moment; the arrival mark cannot stand as proof of presence.
